summary: Great-granddaughter of Bull Smith, wife of Richard Woodhull IV of Setauket and mother of Abraham Woodhull, head of the Culper spy ring.
bio: Margaret Smith was born in 1714, a daughter of Edmund Smith 1st, who was a son of Adam Smith and grandson of Bull Smith. In 1738 she married Richard Woodhull IV (1712–1788) of Setauket. She was the mother of Abraham Woodhull, chief of the Culper Ring during the Revolution, who wrote under the name 'Samuel Culper Sr.'. Abraham's wife Mary Smith was a daughter of Obadiah Smith and Anna, Edmund 1st's daughter by his second wife, so Abraham married his half-first cousin. Margaret died in 1803.
